knowledge.name: Synthetic production-line snapshot
knowledge.detail: Fixed records cover three lines, products, capacity, output, availability, performance, quality, and operating scores.

knowledge.name: Station, defect, and shift evidence
knowledge.detail: Bundled station cycle and takt times, defect rates and mixes, shift hours, staffing, premiums, and output plans support analysis.

knowledge.name: Optimization rules and safety controls
knowledge.detail: Packaged formulas define OEE, gaps, bottlenecks, option gains, shift projections, response framing, and prohibited actions.

knowledge.name: Approved production connection seams
knowledge.detail: Dynamics 365 ERP, Azure IoT Hub, and Power BI are documented future seams only; no live connector is configured.

intelligence_processing.name: Plant-wide line health ranking
intelligence_processing.detail: Ranks all three lines against the 75% operating threshold and identifies availability, performance, quality, and output-loss drivers.

intelligence_processing.name: Constraining-station analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares cycle time with takt and defect evidence to identify each line's bottleneck and the first station for plant-team review.

intelligence_processing.name: Throughput option comparison
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares cycle reduction, parallel capacity, and quality improvement with synthetic gains, costs, and visible quality tradeoffs.

intelligence_processing.name: Three-shift production projection
intelligence_processing.detail: Builds Day, Swing, and Night output and staffing views, including night efficiency and premium, without committing a schedule.

intelligence_processing.name: Intent routing and fail-closed handling
intelligence_processing.detail: Routes plant-floor language to four workflows, defaults to all three lines, and never substitutes or invents unknown records.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: The single-file BasicAgent exposes four deterministic operations through local Brainstem chat, streaming, and API surfaces.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio Draft experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Four skills and two synthetic knowledge files support natural-language previews while the validated pilot remains unpublished.

clients_user_interface.name: Plant-leader review responses
clients_user_interface.detail: Plant managers, engineers, and operations directors receive concise evidence, recommendations, tradeoffs, and no-action limits.

management_reporting.name: Production Line Efficiency Report
management_reporting.detail: Reports OEE, availability, performance, quality, actual versus design output, daily loss, and synthetic annual quality cost.

management_reporting.name: Bottleneck Analysis
management_reporting.detail: Reports each constraining station, cycle-versus-takt delta, defect rate, station table, defect mix, and review priority.

management_reporting.name: Throughput Optimization Recommendations
management_reporting.detail: Reports three improvement options per line, expected gains, investment range, quality target, and projected operating score.

management_reporting.name: Shift Production Plan
management_reporting.detail: Reports Day, Swing, and Night hours, staffing, premiums, projected line output, operator totals, and weekly capacity.

tools.name: ProductionLineOptimizationAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent implements four deterministic, recommendation-only operations over bundled synthetic records.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the portable agent and exposes conversational chat, streaming, health, and tool routing.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the validated Draft pilot with four skills and two knowledge files; publication requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: The host model routes natural-language requests and composes responses from deterministic agent or skill evidence.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 ERP
tools.detail: Documented future seam for approved production context; the packaged pilot has no live read or write connection.

tools.name: Azure IoT Hub approved connector
tools.detail: Documented future seam for verified equipment telemetry; the current package cannot read or control plant equipment.

tools.name: Power BI reporting surface
tools.detail: Documented future seam for governed reporting; the current pilot neither reads dashboards nor publishes production results.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Every line, station, output, cost, staffing value, gain, investment range, and projection is fictional pilot evidence.

supporting_features.name: Four independently routable workflows
supporting_features.detail: Line health, bottleneck analysis, throughput options, and shift planning remain separately callable and reviewable.

supporting_features.name: Visible quality tradeoffs
supporting_features.detail: Every throughput recommendation keeps defect and quality impact visible and retains quality improvement as an explicit option.

supporting_features.name: Plant-leader review gate
supporting_features.detail: Plant managers, production engineers, and operations directors review recommendations before any operational decision.

supporting_features.name: No machine or schedule mutation
supporting_features.detail: Never starts, stops, throttles, reconfigures, or reschedules equipment or shifts, dispatches maintenance, or changes staffing.

supporting_features.name: No commitment or external write
supporting_features.detail: The agent cannot commit investment, headcount, or projected benefits and performs no write to ERP, IoT, Power BI, MES, or other systems.

supporting_features.name: Locked validation and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Four canonical cases passed strict Brainstem and Copilot Studio previews while validated agents remained Draft and unpublished.
